name: Local-to-Global Constraint Translation
description: Replaced a pairwise algebraic constraint with a local sum constraint over all incident edges (net calibration balance). To satisfy the absolute sum condition, all incident edges must have the same orientation, which forces adjacent vertices to have opposite orientations. This completely removes any pairwise equation that can be brute-forced over the domain {1,2}, forcing the model to deduce the bipartite structure through logical analysis of the sum.
